activities.name: Truncate Artifact Tables
activities.description: Clear all artifact tables before reloading to ensure a full, fresh snapshot.

activities.name: Get All Workspaces
activities.description: Call the Fabric REST API to retrieve all workspaces the workspace identity can access.

activities.name: Load Workspaces
activities.description: Bulk-insert all workspaces returned by the API into Metadata.workspaces using OPENJSON.

text.value:
DECLARE @json NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'@{replace(string(activity('Get All Workspaces').output.value), '''', '''''')}';
IF @json IS NOT NULL AND LEN(@json) > 2
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[workspaces] (id, displayName, capacityId, type, loaded_at)
    SELECT id, displayName, capacityId, type, GETDATE()
    FROM OPENJSON(@json)
    WITH (
        id          NVARCHAR(100) '$.id',
        displayName NVARCHAR(255) '$.displayName',
        capacityId  NVARCHAR(100) '$.capacityId',
        type        NVARCHAR(50)  '$.type'
    );
END

activities.name: ForEach Workspace
activities.description: Iterate over every workspace and load its Dataflows, Semantic Models and Pipelines.

activities.name: Get Workspace Dataflows
activities.description: Retrieve all Dataflows in the current workspace.

activities.name: Load Workspace Dataflows
activities.description: Insert the dataflows for this workspace into Metadata.dataflows.

activities.name: Get Workspace Semantic Models
activities.description: Retrieve all Semantic Models in the current workspace.

activities.name: Load Workspace Semantic Models
activities.description: Insert the semantic models for this workspace into Metadata.semantic_models.

activities.name: Get Workspace Pipelines
activities.description: Retrieve all Data Pipelines in the current workspace.

activities.name: Load Workspace Pipelines
activities.description: Insert the pipelines for this workspace into Metadata.pipelines.
